item: Row 361 group 9: the unattended-run line and the field-data line follow a language switch
summary: Three app-diagnostics.js renderers row 365's closure charge found (unattendedStart, unattendedLog, downloadFieldData) wrote t()/tf() output through a local say()/set() closure. The closures now hand a render to ooLive (row 364), so a switch redraws each line; the count is the one at the time it was drawn and the server's words stay as they came. No new strings; the three list lines row 365 added are gone.
